title: Build factorial with Z
description: This Scheme program uses the Z combinator to supply recursive self-reference to a factorial generator.

steps.description: Z takes a function f and builds self-application through lambdas that delay the recursive call with v.
fact-generator accepts self instead of naming itself. Its returned function gives 1 at zero and otherwise calls self on n minus 1.

steps.question: What does applying Z to fact-generator create?
steps.answer: It creates factorial, a function with recursive self-reference supplied by Z.

steps.description: factorial is defined by applying Z to the non-recursive generator.
The two calls show factorial applied to 5 and to the zero base case.
